name: Cable Y-Raise
steps: Set two pulleys to their lowest setting, stand centered between them, and grasp the left cable with your right hand and right cable with your left.
Step slightly back to create tension, brace your core, and keep your elbows straight with your hands crossed in front of your thighs.
Raise both arms diagonally upward and outward into a wide Y shape overhead while keeping your thumbs pointing up.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower both cables smoothly back across your thighs under control.
tips: Keep your rib cage down and avoid leaning backward as your arms rise into the Y position.
Use a light load so your shoulders move smoothly without shrugging toward your ears.
